description: Defines structures and classes for managing DU UE Bearers (SRB and DRB), including connectors, creation, and control functions within the DU manager in a 5G RAN implementation.

classes.name: du_srb_connector
classes.description: Handles connection and disconnection of MAC, RLC, and F1 layers for a DU UE SRB bearer.

classes.name: du_drb_connector
classes.description: Handles connection and disconnection of MAC, RLC, and F1 layers for a DU UE DRB bearer.

classes.name: du_ue_srb
classes.description: Represents an SRB in the DU manager, including configuration, RLC entity, and layer adapters.

classes.name: du_ue_drb
classes.description: Represents a DRB in the DU manager, including configuration, RLC entity, and layer adapters.

classes.name: drb_creation_info
classes.description: Contains parameters needed to create a DRB in the DU.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connections between MAC, RLC, and F1 layers for a bearer.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the bearer from MAC, RLC, and F1 layers.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the SRB or DRB by disconnecting and stopping timers.

methods.name: create_drb
methods.description: Creates and returns a new DRB instance for the DU based on provided parameters.
